scenarios.title: A｜打电话联系
scenarios.setting: 玩家在人很多的景区里和同行人走散，电话终于接通。

turns.prompt: 你想说明可能与朋友走散的位置，会怎么说？

choices.text: I’m not sure. I think we got separated near the main entrance.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not sure. I think we got separated near the main entrance.
feedback.explanation: “entrance”指入口，区别于出口。

choices.text: I lost sight of you when we came out of the gift shop.

feedback.naturalExpression: I lost sight of you when we came out of the gift shop.
feedback.explanation: 提供自己经历或做过的具体情况，让对方能在已知信息上继续确认。

choices.text: I’m near a fountain. Can you see one from where you are?

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m near a fountain. Can you see one from where you are?
feedback.explanation: “Can you …?”直接请对方帮忙，是常见口语请求；使用“can”本身并不等于不礼貌。

choices.text: I think I’m on the other side of the building.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think I’m on the other side of the building.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: I lost you in the crowd.

feedback.naturalExpression: I lost you in the crowd.
feedback.explanation: “lost you in the crowd”表示在人群中和对方走散，并非丢失了物品。

turns.text: I’m standing outside the café near the east entrance.

turns.prompt: 你想请同行人提供所在地点或附近地标，会怎么说？

choices.text: What’s the name of the café?

feedback.naturalExpression: What’s the name of the café?
feedback.explanation: 用“What”明确提出所缺的信息，请对方补充说明，而不是让对方猜自己哪里没听懂。

choices.text: Can you see any signs or landmarks nearby?

feedback.naturalExpression: Can you see any signs or landmarks nearby?
feedback.explanation: “Can you …?”直接请对方帮忙，是常见口语请求；使用“can”本身并不等于不礼貌。

choices.text: Stay there. I’ll try to find you.

feedback.naturalExpression: Stay there. I’ll try to find you.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: I’m not sure where the east entrance is. Can you tell me how to get there?

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not sure where the east entrance is. Can you tell me how to get there?
feedback.explanation: “entrance”指入口，区别于出口。

turns.text: There’s a big information desk right next to me.

turns.prompt: 关于「与同行人走散」，你想说明自己接下来能做什么或打算怎么做，会怎么说？

choices.text: Okay, I know where that is. I’ll meet you there.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay, I know where that is. I’ll meet you there.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Great. Don’t move—I’ll be there in a few minutes.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. Don’t move—I’ll be there in a few minutes.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

scenarios.title: B｜请工作人员帮助
scenarios.setting: 玩家联系不上同行人，于是找到景区工作人员。

turns.text: Excuse me. I’ve gotten separated from the person I’m traveling with.
Have you been able to contact them?

turns.prompt: 关于「与同行人走散」，对方在核实情况，你会怎样回答并补充必要的信息？

choices.text: I’ve tried calling, but they’re not answering.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’ve tried calling, but they’re not answering.
feedback.explanation: 先交代一部分情况，再补充限制或不同之处，避免对方只根据前半句作判断。

choices.text: Their phone seems to be turned off.

feedback.naturalExpression: Their phone seems to be turned off.
feedback.explanation: “seems to be turned off”表示看起来已关机，保留自己无法完全确认的余地。

choices.text: We got separated about twenty minutes ago.

feedback.naturalExpression: We got separated about twenty minutes ago.
feedback.explanation: 提供自己经历或做过的具体情况，让对方能在已知信息上继续确认。

choices.text: We were together near the main exhibition hall.

feedback.naturalExpression: We were together near the main exhibition hall.
feedback.explanation: “together”强调双方一起参与或同处一处，适合商量共同安排。

choices.text: I can’t find my friend anywhere. Could you help me?

feedback.naturalExpression: I can’t find my friend anywhere. Could you help me?
feedback.explanation: “I can’t”明确说明无法完成的动作或限制，方便对方判断需要什么帮助或替代办法。

turns.text: Do you have a meeting point arranged?

turns.prompt: 关于「与同行人走散」，对方在核实情况，你会怎样回答并补充必要的信息？

choices.text: No, unfortunately we didn’t arrange one.

feedback.naturalExpression: No, unfortunately we didn’t arrange one.
feedback.explanation: 明确说明哪件事没有发生或无法进行，把问题落在具体动作上。

choices.text: We said we’d meet at the entrance if we got separated, but there are several entrances.

feedback.naturalExpression: We said we’d meet at the entrance if we got separated, but there are several entrances.
feedback.explanation: “entrance”指入口，区别于出口。

choices.text: Not really. Is there somewhere you recommend I wait?

feedback.naturalExpression: Not really. Is there somewhere you recommend I wait?
feedback.explanation: “not really”是较温和的否定，常表示不太符合或并不怎么做。

turns.text: You can wait by the information desk. It’s easy to find.

turns.prompt: 你想请工作人员帮助寻找走散的同行人，会怎么说？

choices.text: Could you show me where it is?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you show me where it is?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Is there a way to make an announcement?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there a way to make an announcement?
feedback.explanation: 先确认有没有所需的物品、服务或安排，为后面的选择提供依据。

choices.text: If they ask another staff member for help, will they be directed there too?

feedback.naturalExpression: If they ask another staff member for help, will they be directed there too?
feedback.explanation: 先确认后续安排能否实现，便于对方说明条件、时间或限制。

scenarios.title: C｜约定集合地点
scenarios.setting: 玩家重新联系上同行人，但双方都不清楚对方具体在哪里，于是决定停止互相寻找，约一个明确地点。

turns.text: I keep walking around, but I still can’t find you.

turns.prompt: 关于「与同行人走散」，你想提出一个接下来的做法或安排，会怎么建议？

choices.text: Let’s stop looking for each other and meet somewhere specific.

feedback.naturalExpression: Let’s stop looking for each other and meet somewhere specific.
feedback.explanation: “looking for”表示正在寻找，区别于强调找到结果的“find”。

choices.text: How about meeting at the main entrance?

feedback.naturalExpression: How about meeting at the main entrance?
feedback.explanation: “entrance”指入口，区别于出口。

choices.text: Let’s meet by the information desk. It’ll be easier to find.

feedback.naturalExpression: Let’s meet by the information desk. It’ll be easier to find.
feedback.explanation: 把安排作为共同商量的建议提出，方便对方接受、调整或补充。

choices.text: Why don’t we both go back to the café we passed earlier?

feedback.naturalExpression: Why don’t we both go back to the café we passed earlier?
feedback.explanation: 把安排作为共同商量的建议提出，方便对方接受、调整或补充。

choices.text: Let’s decide one place and meet there.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Let’s stop looking for each other and meet somewhere specific.
feedback.explanation: “decide on a place”需要“on”；也可说“meet somewhere specific”，强调约好明确地点。

turns.text: The information desk sounds good. Which one?

turns.prompt: 你想说清楚双方要集合的具体位置，会怎么说？

choices.text: The one next to the east entrance.

feedback.naturalExpression: The one next to the east entrance.
feedback.explanation: “the one”指代前面已谈到的人或物；补充位置或特征，就能区分具体是哪一个。

choices.text: The information desk on the ground floor, near the gift shop.

feedback.naturalExpression: The information desk on the ground floor, near the gift shop.
feedback.explanation: 用具体规格或位置回应对方，便于落实选择；上下文已明确时，不必重复整项需求。

choices.text: I’ll send you the location if I can.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’ll send you the location if I can.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: If you can’t find it, ask a staff member for the east entrance.

feedback.naturalExpression: If you can’t find it, ask a staff member for the east entrance.
feedback.explanation: “can’t find”表示目前找不到，不直接断定物品丢失或被偷。

turns.text: Okay. How long will it take you to get there?

turns.prompt: 对方在确认时间或时长，你会怎样补充信息？

choices.text: Probably about ten minutes.

feedback.naturalExpression: Probably about ten minutes.
feedback.explanation: 用时间短语标明时点或持续时长，让对方能据此安排，而不只知道一个模糊的“晚点”。

choices.text: I’m pretty close. I’ll be there in five minutes.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m pretty close. I’ll be there in five minutes.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: I’m not sure, so just wait there until I arrive.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not sure, so just wait there until I arrive.
feedback.explanation: 明确表达不确定，让对方知道需要进一步确认，而不是把猜测当作事实。

choices.text: If I’m not there in fifteen minutes, call me again.

feedback.naturalExpression: If I’m not there in fifteen minutes, call me again.
feedback.explanation: 加上条件说明请求或安排的适用范围，让对方可以结合实际限制回应。

turns.prompt: 你想友好地结束这段交流，会怎么说？

choices.text: Perfect. See you there.

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect. See you there.
feedback.explanation: 用简短告别为对话收尾，既确认交流结束，也保留友好的语气。

choices.text: Great. Don’t move this time.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. Don’t move this time.
feedback.explanation: 明确说明哪件事没有发生或无法进行，把问题落在具体动作上。

choices.text: Okay. I’ll head there now.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. I’ll head there now.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。
